title: 4 Poems at Aphor Magazine

research.excerpt: Pews shimmered with the trash can tin like a lake / so that the church was forced to change / its name to The Holy Congregation / of I Love You Dammit, How Can I Make You See That.

notes: Founding Publications. Poems dated Jul 18 (Small Town Skin, What Belongs to Whom) and Aug 1 (Orbits, Sense Data). pubDate uses latest (2025-08-01).
